description: A real EVE client undocks, holds what the server put on its grid, and docks again. Needs the client-agent patch and an EVE client: gridcheck doctor says whether both are there.

setup.note: account e2eclient, character Client Observer, docked where a new character starts
answers once the client is in space
waits until the client holds what the server's grid holds
the nearest station: the one it undocked from; waits out the client's session-change timer first
docked again: the lobby is back

expect.note: after the undock, the client held every ball the server's grid held, and nothing else
no ball stayed on the server's grid for 10 s without reaching the client
the client held no ball for 10 s that the server's grid didn't
the content-host lookups the client fails at login and at every undock and dock are noise, so they don't count
